description: Implementation of AddressReadPlatformService for retrieving address data from database, including methods for fetching addresses by various filters, mapping SQL result sets to AddressData objects, and retrieving code value options.

classes.name: AddressReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing address data retrieval logic with database access and filtering.

classes.name: AddFieldsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to AddressData with address fields.

classes.name: AddMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to AddressData with address and address type details.

methods.name: retrieveAddressFields
methods.description: Fetches address fields for a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientAddress
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a client.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyType
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a client filtered by address type.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a client filtered by address type and active status.

methods.name: retrieveAddressbyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves addresses for a client filtered by active status.

methods.name: retrieveBySearchParam
methods.description: Retrieves addresses based on search parameters with filtering rules.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template AddressData with code value options for country, state, and address type.
